LESSON: EARLY CIVILISATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.2: Early Civilisation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Early Civilisation. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How has early African civilisation influenced the world today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the contribution of ancient kingdoms to the development of the modern world

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EARLY CIVILISATION
This lesson teaches Early Civilisation for Grade 7 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. appreciate the contribution of ancient kingdoms to the development of the modern world
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Early Civilisation using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Early Civilisation above.
2. Explain Early Civilisation to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Early Civilisation.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Early Civilisation with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Early Civilisation important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How has early African civilisation influenced the world today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the contribution of ancient kingdoms to the development of the modern world

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
